## LLM004 SseEmitter without a timeout

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Level | error |
| Framework | Both |
| Autofix | no patch; fix it by hand as described below |
| More | https://pgy763.github.io/llm-dev-pitfalls/java/SSE连接30秒断开 |
| Turn it off | `LLM004: off` in .llm-lint.yml, or `--disable LLM004` on the command line |

new SseEmitter() uses the container's default timeout (30 seconds on Tomcat). The connection is cut before the model finishes generating, and the front end sees an answer that stops halfway.

To mute it in one place, put `// llm-lint:ignore LLM004` on that line or the line above.
<!-- /generated:llm004 -->

## What it looks like

`new SseEmitter()` with no argument inside a streaming endpoint.

## How to fix

Pass the longest answer you allow, e.g. `new SseEmitter(180_000L)`. For no timeout pass `0` on purpose and add `onTimeout` / `onCompletion`.
